name: Skydive
description: Gives cloud agents their own computer with a browser, filesystem, and terminal, then makes them reachable over Slack, email, and iMessage. Supports 170+ models.

skills.name: Agent Workstation
skills.description: Provisions each cloud agent a persistent computer with browser, filesystem, and terminal access it keeps between runs.

skills.name: Messaging Surface
skills.description: Exposes agents through Slack, email, and iMessage so people delegate work from tools they already use.

skills.name: Model Selection
skills.description: Runs the same agent against any of 170+ supported models, switching providers without rewriting the agent.
